Risk Purchase (RPN) Clause: Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreemen t, if the Supplier neglects or fails to perform the Agreement by the agreed time(s), for any reason other than Force Majeure, the Purchaser, upon becoming aware of such n egligence or non-performance, shall give the Supplier 14 to 30 days’ notice, or such extended period as may be mutually agreed, to rectify the default.
